ruleDefinitions.name: Certificate-Based Authentication Enabled
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when certificate based authentication has been enabled in an Azure Active Directory tenant. Note: Unmapped fields: OperationName, TargetResources.modifiedProperties

sequences.query: (OperationName = "Authentication\ Methods\ Policy\ Update" AND TargetResources.modifiedProperties = RGX(".*AuthenticationMethodsPolicy.*"))
